days.title: 반야심경 5
days.prompt: 얻으려 애쓰던 것 하나를 떠올려 보세요.

days.title: 반야심경 6

days.title: 반야심경 7

days.title: 반야심경 8

days.title: 반야심경 9

days.title: 반야심경 전체

days.title: 법성게 1–5구

days.title: 법성게 6–10구

days.prompt: 처음 마음을 냈던 순간을 떠올려 보세요.

days.title: 법성게 16–20구
days.prompt: 삶과 열반이 함께 어우러진다는 말을 오늘 하루에 비추어 보세요.

days.title: 법성게 21–25구
days.prompt: 쉬고 싶은 생각 하나를 적어 보세요.

days.title: 법성게 26–30구

days.title: 신심명 1–4구
days.prompt: 좋고 싫음을 잠시 내려놓고 천천히 써 보세요.

days.title: 신심명 5–8구

days.title: 신심명 13–16구

days.title: 신심명 17–20구

days.title: 신심명 21–24구

days.prompt: 다 쓰고 나서 마음에 남은 한 구절을 적어 보세요.

en.title: Sutra Copying, 27 Days
en.subtitle: Heart Sutra, Beopseongge, Faith in Mind
en.summary: Four weeks that copy the Heart Sutra and the Song of Dharma Nature in parts and in full, then Faith in Mind.
highlights: Four weeks, one page a day
Finish it and bind your handwriting into a notebook
First 3 days are free

days.title: Heart Sutra 1
days.prompt: Before you begin, take three quiet breaths.

days.title: Heart Sutra 2
days.prompt: Try letting go of one thought you were holding today.

days.title: Heart Sutra 3
days.prompt: Is there anything comforting about the words neither increasing nor decreasing?

days.title: Heart Sutra 4
days.prompt: Which was busiest today: your eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, or mind?

days.title: Heart Sutra 5
days.prompt: Bring to mind one thing you have been trying hard to gain.

days.title: Heart Sutra 6
days.prompt: If your heart had no hindrance, what would you like to do today?

days.title: Heart Sutra 7
days.prompt: One character at a time, bring your attention to the hand that writes.

days.title: Heart Sutra 8
days.prompt: Write down one phrase that helps you feel at ease.

days.title: Heart Sutra 9
days.prompt: Mantras are traditionally recited for their sound as much as their meaning. Try reading it aloud once.

days.title: Full Heart Sutra
days.prompt: After writing it from beginning to end, note how your heart feels.

days.title: Lines 1–5
days.prompt: Write slowly, holding the thought that stillness is our original place.

days.title: Lines 6–10
days.prompt: Bring to mind one person you are connected to.

days.title: Lines 11–15
days.prompt: Remember the moment you first set your intention.

days.title: Lines 16–20
days.prompt: Reflect on today through the thought that life and nirvana belong together.

days.title: Lines 21–25
days.prompt: Write down one thought you would like to let rest.

days.title: Lines 26–30
days.prompt: What does the home you want to return to today look like?

days.title: Full Beopseongge
days.prompt: After you finish, write down the line that stays with you the longest.

days.title: Lines 1–4
days.prompt: Set aside likes and dislikes for a moment and write slowly.

days.title: Lines 5–8
days.prompt: Recall a time when a small difference grew into a wide gap.

days.title: Lines 9–12
days.prompt: Have you ever grown noisier inside by trying hard to be calm?

days.title: Lines 13–16
days.prompt: Write down one thing that lacks nothing just as it is.

days.title: Lines 17–20
days.prompt: What would you like to look at today with an even mind?

days.title: Lines 21–24
days.prompt: Is there a thought that moved more the harder you tried to stop it?

days.title: Lines 25–28
days.prompt: Is there something you held tighter while trying to let it go?

days.title: Lines 29–32
days.prompt: If you set down one word and one thought today, what would they be?

days.title: Lines 33–36
days.prompt: Pause for a moment and turn to look at your mind now.

days.title: Closing lines
days.prompt: When you finish, write the line that stays with you.

ja.title: 経典の写経 27日

days.title: 般若心経 1
days.prompt: 書く前に、呼吸を三回ととのえてから始めてみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 2
days.prompt: 今日つかんでいた思いをひとつ手放してみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 3
days.prompt: 増えも減りもしないという言葉に、なぐさめられることはありますか。

days.title: 般若心経 4
days.prompt: 目、耳、鼻、舌、体、心のうち、今日いちばん忙しく使ったのはどれですか。

days.title: 般若心経 5
days.prompt: 得ようとがんばっていたものを、ひとつ思い出してみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 6
days.prompt: 心にさまたげがなかったら、今日何をしたいですか。

days.title: 般若心経 7
days.prompt: 一字ずつ、書く手に心を集めてみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 8
days.prompt: 自分を楽にしてくれるひと言を書いてみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 9
days.prompt: 真言は意味よりも音のままに唱える伝統があります。声に出して一度読んでみましょう。

days.title: 般若心経 全文
days.prompt: 初めから終わりまで書いたあと、いまの心もちを書いてみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 1〜5句
days.prompt: 静けさがもとの居場所だという言葉を思いながら、ゆっくり書いてみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 6〜10句
days.prompt: あなたとつながっている人を、ひとり思い浮かべてみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 11〜15句
days.prompt: はじめて心を起こした瞬間を思い出してみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 16〜20句
days.prompt: 生きることと涅槃がともに溶け合うという言葉を、今日一日に照らしてみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 21〜25句
days.prompt: 休ませたい思いを、ひとつ書いてみましょう。

days.title: 法性偈 26〜30句
days.prompt: 今日帰りたい家は、どんな姿をしていますか。

days.title: 信心銘 1〜4句
days.prompt: 好き嫌いをしばらく置いて、ゆっくり書いてみましょう。

days.title: 信心銘 5〜8句
days.prompt: 小さなずれが大きく広がったことを思い出してみましょう。

days.title: 信心銘 9〜12句

days.title: 信心銘 13〜16句

days.title: 信心銘 17〜20句
days.prompt: 今日、平らな心で見つめたいことは何ですか。

days.title: 信心銘 21〜24句
days.prompt: 止めようとするほど動いた思いはありますか。

days.title: 信心銘 25〜28句
days.prompt: 捨てようとして、かえってしがみついたものはありますか。

days.title: 信心銘 29〜32句
days.prompt: 今日、言葉をひとつ、思いをひとつ減らすとしたら何ですか。

days.title: 信心銘 33〜36句
days.prompt: 少し立ち止まって、いまの心をふり返ってみましょう。

days.title: 信心銘 結び
days.prompt: 書き終えて、心に残った一句を書いてみましょう。

days.title: 信心銘 17–20句

days.title: 信心銘 21–24句

days.title: 信心銘 25–28句

days.title: 信心銘 29–32句

days.title: 信心銘 33–36句

days.title: 信心銘 結語
days.prompt: 寫完之後，記下留在心裡的一句。

en.title: Leaving Home and Nirvana, 28 Days
en.subtitle: From the day he left home to his parinirvana
en.summary: From the night the prince saw old age, sickness and death and left the palace, through the last teachings of the Long Discourses and the Bequeathed Teaching, to the Great Parinirvana Sutra, one page a day. Between the day of his leaving home and the day of his nirvana, write by hand his last words: practice with diligence.
highlights: 4 weeks, one page a day
Finish and you have a notebook in your own handwriting
A new book for Plus members first

days.title: Old age comes like lightning
days.prompt: How do you look at the ways time has changed you?

days.title: Where there is a body, there is illness
days.prompt: Who stayed by your side when you were unwell?

days.title: Whatever begins must end
days.prompt: Because all things end, what would you like to cherish more?

days.title: Meeting one who had left home
days.prompt: Have you ever seen a way of living that drew your heart?

days.title: Leaving the city
days.prompt: Is there something you left behind in order to begin anew?

days.title: Cutting off his hair
days.prompt: What would you like to lightly set down today?

days.title: I will carry them across
days.prompt: Is there someone you would like to be a help to?

days.title: Delighting in few affairs
days.prompt: Is there some talk or task you would like to do less of today?

days.title: The ferryman on the sea
days.prompt: Who has been a bridge to help you across?

days.title: Like an old cart
days.prompt: Would you like to thank your body today for all these years together?

days.title: The body is not our own
days.prompt: Is there a meeting made more precious because partings come?

days.title: Guard your own mind
days.prompt: What state of mind would you like to guard today?

days.title: The true offering
days.prompt: If you put one thing you have learned into practice today, what would it be?

days.title: Leaving home at twenty-nine
days.prompt: Looking back on the long road you have walked, how do you feel?

days.title: Like a bee among flowers
days.prompt: What would you like to take only as much of as you need today?

days.title: The fire of impermanence
days.prompt: Is there something you have put off that you would like to begin today?

days.title: Anger is fiercer than fire
days.prompt: Do you have your own way of cooling down when anger rises?

days.title: Like putting on armor
days.prompt: When you go somewhere that unsettles you, what would you like to carry in your mind?

days.title: A good doctor, a good guide
days.prompt: Is there a resolution, like medicine, that you know of but have not yet taken?

days.title: Encourage yourselves
days.prompt: What would you like to keep going this week, encouraging yourself along?

days.title: As long as it is passed on
days.prompt: Is there a good habit you would like to pass on to someone?

days.title: All returns to impermanence
days.prompt: Who would you like to treat more tenderly while they are near?

days.title: Even Mount Sumeru, even the sea
days.prompt: Is there something you hold on to, wishing it would never change?

days.title: A body like lightning
days.prompt: What do you feel in your body at this moment?

days.title: Guarding the precepts like your eyes
days.prompt: What promise would you like to guard as carefully as your own eyes?

days.title: The teaching is your teacher
days.prompt: What line would you like to keep as a teacher for your heart?

days.title: As a lamp goes out
days.prompt: Do you have your own way of ending the day quietly?

days.title: The final teaching
days.prompt: How will you carry on tomorrow the practice you kept up for 28 days?
